deviations_from_card: (1) Verdict.was is {text, verdict} plus an optional `fix`, carried only when the replaced verdict had its own fix. A verdict that holds is strong or neutral and carries no fix, so without was.fix the page could not ink the move it taught. With no own fix, the page falls back to the lens's playbook move. Case 3 deepEquals {text, verdict:'faulty'} for a verdict with no fix, and {text, verdict, fix} for one that had a fix. (2) `was` keeps the FIRST reading of the sentence across repeated rewrites (before.was ?? the old sentence), so the ghost and the before/after always compare against the paragraph as it was read. (3) revise refuses one more case than the card lists: a rewrite that would not re-split into the same sentences where it stands, for example a lower-case start that merges with the sentence before. The numbering every highlight is drawn on stays true. Case 2 covers this refusal. A sentence number that is not an integer is also refused with 400. (4) New pure helper rules/essay taught(v, playbook). EssayTV's teaching() and desk/essay.ts's prompt both use it, so the move the TV shows and the move the model is asked about come from one rule. cleanFix is no longer imported by EssayTV. (5) The forensic caption slot gains three states from the same session: 'Reading' while the sentence:n job runs, 'Not read' + job.error when it failed, and 'Rewrite · it holds' or 'Rewrite · not yet' + the model's note. (6) The phone's sentence panel also has a Dictate button beside the one Send, as the paragraph panel does. (7) No new phone hand-off: forensic already maps to the 'paste' panel (panelFor.ts). The panel now renders the sentence editor there, so panelFor.ts and phone-panel-test are unchanged and green. (8) Commit order is feat x3, then the test commit. Red-before (7 of 7 non-guard cases) was measured in the working tree before any source change. desk/package.json is untouched: both suites were already in test:rules. (9) The browser gate stubbed the text engine by editing claudeCli.run in the TEMP COPY only. The route's revise/reviseSentence/essay.revised path ran for real on the dev server, and no model was called.
notes: NEW API: POST /api/analyse {kind:'rewrite', n:number, text:string}. With no reading on the desk, or anything rules/essay revise() refuses, it answers 400 {error} (desk-worded) with no run and no engine call. Otherwise it runs the 'analyse' job with key 'sentence:<n>' (409 while one runs), dispatches essay.revised when the reading on the desk is still the one asked about, and answers 200 with the revised EssayAnalysis. Status line on done: 'sentence n holds now' or 'sentence n still needs the move'. NEW EVENT: {type:'essay.revised', analysis, n} is SERVER_ONLY ('Send the rewritten sentence to /api/analyse.'). The reducer sets essay and essayAt=n (when it exists) and subject essay; the screen becomes forensic with focus 0 only when it was not already forensic. It is not in REHYDRATE, and it writes no history entry and no writing record. Verdict gains optional `was?: {text, verdict, fix?}` (type Was in rules/essay). Every other consumer (landingRows, recapRows, keys, pairing view) reads verdict only and is unaffected. rules/essay exports added at the end: VerdictLike, Was, ReadingLike, revise, RewriteState, rewriteState, taught. desk/essay.ts exports reviseSentence(reading, n, text). EssayTV: the Rail row carries data-rewrite=none|holds|still. A rewritten row draws <span class=em-ghost data-role=essay-ghost> (CSS in essay-specimen.css after .em-r.bad). The phone chip `lit` is still status-derived; only `inked` changed. Phone: the Essay tab renders [data-role=essay-rewrite] ('Sentence n', a textarea prefilled with s.essay.sentences[forensicAt(s)].text, Dictate, one Send) whenever s.screen==='forensic' and a reading exists, and the paragraph editor otherwise. The prefill resets only when the sentence's n or text changes. Screenshots are in the builder scratchpad, not the tree: .../scratchpad/rw-b/f1-before.png (hatched), f2-pressed.png (Rewrite pressed, chip lit, still hatched), f3-holds.png (inked CONCEDE, THEN TURN IT BACK; reversed ghost under the forward arrow on row 4), f4-still.png (sentence 6 still faulty, hatched SAY WHY, 'Rewrite · not yet'), p1-sentence4.png (phone prefilled), p2-sent.png. The journey is journey.cjs, with seed.cjs beside it. The temp desk copy is deleted and the dev server on :3297 is stopped. The full desk gate ran with siblings' in-flight Linga/uat files present and was green.
